context.why: US2 (T009-T012) is built: sample and measurement views and fields, depends_on, and the measurement form's sample field as SampleChoiceField(depends_on='dataset'). The maintainer ruled on 2026-10-21 that FS-006 FR-006 stands: a measurement may name a sample from another dataset. The spec's US 2 is amended (read spec.md, User Story 2 and FR-004): the sample field offers every sample the person may see; once a dataset is chosen in the form, that dataset's samples come first in a group of their own ('Samples in this dataset'), and the rest follow; a sample from another dataset the person may see is accepted; one they may not see is refused. T035: add a `prefer` argument to the record fields (beside depends_on) that sends the other field's value to the view so it ranks and groups matching records first, WITHOUT narrowing and WITHOUT affecting validation. The view must accept the preference value only for the same allow-listed relation names (dataset) and treat it as ordering/grouping only. Switch MeasurementFormMixin.sample to prefer='dataset'. Rework the US2 tests you or the earlier implementer wrote for the cross-dataset refusal (in tests/test_contrib/test_autocomplete/ and tests/test_core/test_measurement/test_forms.py) to the amended scenarios. The pre-existing test_form_handles_cross_dataset_sample_reference must then pass unchanged; do not edit it. depends_on stays, still tested on its own field. Also correct any docs US2 changed that now describe narrowing on the measurement form (record-fields.md, measurements.md), and revert any doc lines that removed the cross-dataset description. Other stories since: US3 (filters) and US5 (person/organization fields) are on the branch; leave them alone.
prior_decisions: D1: a field that places a record inside another needs edit; linking needs view; a public list filter offers public records only, to everyone.
D3: visibility rules are taken as they stand (project by visibility; dataset by get_visible on all_objects; sample/measurement by public+published dataset).
D4: a stored link to a record the editor cannot see is kept and shown as a private record without its name.
D12: limits on the pattern of fairdm/api/throttling.py, refused before any query.

D13: design review. django-tomselect rebuilds the validation view as view_class() (lazy_utils.py:107) and with the current page's q/f/e. So: one view subclass per scope (scope is a class attribute), and FairDM fields validate through the view's offered(user, owner=, type=, depends_on=) and never call django-tomselect's clean(). Use django-tomselect's allowed_filter_fields and allowed_ordering_fields, not a custom allow-list.
Upstream gaps are tracked in this repository's issue #554. Put '#554' in the comments of the two django_tomselect templates.
FR-021 (the 'searching is paused' message) is with the maintainer. Do NOT build it and do NOT write a skipped test for it.
